technology_name: A VENTILATED DISC BRAKE COATED WITH GRAPHENE-WRAPPED RUTILE-TiO2 INFUSED ALUMINUM ALLOY AND METHOD OF MANUFACTURING
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard cast-iron automotive brake discs suffer from severe thermal fading, rapid abrasive friction wear, and release toxic metallic particulate dust during heavy braking cycles.
description: A high-conductivity ventilated automotive disc brake body fabricated from an advanced lightweight aluminum alloy augmented with a permanent surface coating layer containing graphene-wrapped rutile titanium dioxide ($TiO_2$) nanoparticles.
applications: High-performance electric vehicle deceleration loops, aviation landing gear brakes, heavy industrial crane braking plates, and motorsport braking systems.
